sheets.title: A wrong password on the unlock screen — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The unlock screen has no shell, so it had no bell, and the failure was a red box in the card (432×44). Now the box is gone, the card keeps its height, and a corner bell (35×39, top right) carries a dot for the notice.
sheets.before: red box in the unlock card
sheets.after: no box · corner bell with a dot

sheets.title: The corner bell opened — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Before, there was nowhere to open: the screen drew no bell. After, the bell opens the tray, which holds the sentence with a dismiss key.

sheets.title: A wrong password, phone — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The same screen on a phone: the red box (324×44) is gone and the corner bell keeps a 44×44 target under a coarse pointer.
sheets.before: red box in the unlock card
sheets.after: no box · corner bell with a dot

sheets.title: The corner bell opened — 390 × 844
